intro: A metallic black box has turned up in a giant condor's stomach in the Badlands, its surface heavily pitted as if left in acid. Stamped on its underside, beneath a symbol, is a mark reading Engine #19 - Ironforge Siege Brigade.

paras: The surface of this metallic black box is heavily pitted, as if it had been immersed in acid - it must have been sitting in the giant condor's stomach for a long time.
